title: sdlc-plan-epics-order
description: Machine-readable order of a project's epics. sdlc-tracker-sync swaps draft keys in it when it publishes the epics and mirrors every depends_on edge as a Jira 'blocks' link.

project_key.description: the Jira project, as in epic-map.json

epic_key.description: e.g. LEARN-11, or FA-2-PENDING before publishing

wave.description: 1 = no dependencies; N = depends only on waves < N

depends_on.description: epic keys this epic is blocked by

mvp_path.description: epic keys needed to deliver every MVP requirement

cycles.description: circular dependencies flagged for a person to re-slice (empty if clean)
